summary: Rising Dragon Acquisition Corp. filed a Form 8-K reporting shareholder approval to extend the SPAC combination deadline from July 15, 2026 up to October 15, 2027 via monthly deposits of the lesser of $100,000 or $0.033 per non-redeeming public share into the trust. No business combination or target is announced; the filing details trust agreement amendments and charter changes typical of routine SPAC extension management without a transaction. This is an administrative step, not a special-situation event. Watch for future target announcement or liquidation risk if no deal closes.
